“We know the next two games are going to be a battle.”

Enzo and his squad are ready for action, as we prepare to take on Liverpool and Paris Saint-Germain.

Did you know Morgan Rogers played for @afcbournemouth? 🍒

The midfielder made 17 appearances for the Cherries across the 2021/22 season 🤝

"They are just focused, in this moment, on how we can beat Liverpool.”

Enzo says our players are focused on the task ahead, starting with a trip to Anfield on Sunday.

“We need to be all together!"

Enzo calls on our travelling fans to bring their voices as we look to maintain our 100% start to the season.

Watch the full interview
https://mancity.co/EnzoIV
The first time was so nice, @BukayoSaka87 had to do it twice 👊

"We have to stay positive, look ahead and try to win football games."

🗣️ @Erling previews this weekend's trip to Anfield.

A Premier League debut at just 15-years-old.
